description: 1% Salicylic Acid Face Wash (Foam-Based) with Glycolic Acid (AHA BHA) Reduces Acne: This 1% Salicylic Acid Face Wash (Foam-Based) with Glycolic Acid is the first step in a routine targetted at reducing acne and comedones. Exfoliates Dead Skin Cells: Glycolic and Salicylic acids are chemical exfoliants with antibacterial properties. 1% Salicylic Acid Face Wash (Foam-Based) unclogs pores, gently removes build-up & blackheads and treats acne-prone skin without drying out the skin of its natural oils. Tightens Pores: Our anti-acne face wash for women unclogs pores and destroys acne-causing bacteria, preventing future breakouts and shrinking open pores. Regulates Sebum Production: Glycolic acid removes surface build-up and salicylic acid removes excessive oil from the pores thereby reducing oiliness For best results, use for 2 months. 120 ml | Lasts one month

list.title: Full list of ingredients
list.content:
Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

Formulated Without
Fragrance, Parabens, Sulfates, Phthalates, Gluten, Animal-Derived Ingredients, Petrolatum/Petroleum

list.title: Why is this oil control face wash soap-free?
list.content: Soap-free cleansers are suitable for sensitive skin and keep your skin away from irritation. Another fantastic benefit of soap-free face cleansers is that they do not over dry your skin.

list.title: My skin type is dry, can I use this 1% Salicylic Acid Face Wash (Foam-Based) for women?
list.content: We recommend using a hydrating cleanser as the active ingredients in the 1% Salicylic Acid Face Wash (Foam-Based) may cause minor dryness.

list.title: Is this an SLS and Paraben-free face wash for women?
list.content: We promise to keep all harmful chemicals at bay from our products. Hence, this foaming face wash is SLS, Paraben and soap-free.

list.title: Are there any side effects of this Face Wash containing salicylic acid and glycolic acid?
list.content: This facewash may cause minor dryness. Reduce usage to once daily if excessive dryness or peeling occurs. Do not use with retinol based products.
